_comment: Reviewer fixture for the zero-shot foundation-model ceiling row of
as a fallback when no live metrics/foundation_metrics.json is available
(the API arm requires an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY environment
variable and is opt-in via config.foundation_enabled).
Numbers are conservative zero-shot ceilings drawn from contemporary
frontier multimodal LLM evaluations on receipt KIE; the production arm
overwrites them by writing metrics/foundation_metrics.json with the
real cached responses (see models/foundation_oracle.py).  Keys mirror
the live side-car schema so the consumer is identical.
